item.title: Homes: The luxury of staying put
item.description: For many homeowners, a builder-basic townhouse is a stepping stone, a temporary stop until something bigger, brighter or more bespoke comes along. But the owner of this uptown Toronto townhouse took a different view. Rather than move on to greener pastures, she decided to stay put. “She loves the location and the benefits of maintenance-free condo living,” says designer Evelyn Eshun, who was tasked with transforming the space for the […]
